Name: Hexness Bluegrass Fix for Flowergrass and Snowfields
Author: Hexnessie
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I've been using Alvadea's Flowergrass and Snowfields mod for a long time even though it does not support bluegrass, because I just love the look of those flowery meadows so much. As the mod is based on More Grass framework, bluegrass cannot be natively supported. To fix it, this mod moves Flowergrass to a different framework called "Grass Variety" that works with newer grass types. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The bluegrass sprites may not be much to look at now, but at least they clearly show where the special grass is located. I will try to make the graphics better in future updates. Also, if you don't like the looks, you can easily replace the tilesheet with your own![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Things that currently DON'T work:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Snowfields in spots where bluegrass grows. Sprites for snowfields will be added in the next update. [/color]

[size=4][b]Creator's Notice[/b][/size]
[b][color=#ffff00][u]NO AI WAS USED IN THE CREATION OF THIS MOD.[/u][/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] The sprites are based on handpainted and slightly redesigned game resources created by Concerned Ape. If for some unfathomable reason you would like to use the sprites somewhere else, please let me know![/color]

Manifest.Name: Hexness Bluegrass Fix
Manifest.Description: Fixes blue grass display in Alvadea's mod, and moves the mod to a different grass framework that supports bluegrass
Manifest.Author: Hexnessie
